components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS',
            'MS' or 'DR'. When present it is stored and returned, and is used to
            compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On
            output it is the composed address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same way (upper-cased,
            whitespace-collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. a unit or suite). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 2'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional; when present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner, exactly 4 digits. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed city-to-region postcode table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. It is stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and the same postcode (the same household). It only bypasses
            the household-duplicate block; the owner is created as a declared household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; it is used
            only at creation time and is neither stored nor returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, '/api/owners/' followed by
                the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space and
                the last name (e.g. 'DR Who') when a title is present, or just the
                last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The integer version of the owner response shape. Always 2 for this
                version-2 owner identity release.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identity, grouping the derived identifiers
                (memberId, identityKey and householdId). Each identifier mixes in a
                fixed 'V2' version tag, so no value produced under version 1 is produced
                again. The user-facing 'locality', 'timezone' and 'ownerSegment' remain
                the plain region code and never carry the 'V2' tag.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named
                by the calendar year in which it ends, so a registration date on or
                after 1 July belongs to the following calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, the score the membershipLevel is
                derived from. Starts at 0 and gains 2 when an email address is
                present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2
                for a household of 3 or more members (householdSize is at least
                3), and 3 when the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed
                fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). A newly created
                owner (zero tenure) is never awarded the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-

                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points,
                level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region component of the member id (its leading letters, before
                the fiscal-year digits), the region derived from the postcode
                (falling back to the fixed city-to-region table Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD); 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true

              title: Owner segment

                when the membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA
                is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:

                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL

              readOnly: true

                via the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Null when the
                region is not one of these.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS',
            'MS' or 'DR'. When present it is stored and returned, and is used to
            compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On
            output it is the composed address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same way (upper-cased,
            whitespace-collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. a unit or suite). When present it is normalized and appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 2'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            normalized E.164 value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional; when present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner, exactly 4 digits. Optional; when present it must be
            valid for the owner's city per a fixed city-to-region postcode table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. It is stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and the same postcode (the same household). It only bypasses
            the household-duplicate block; the owner is created as a declared household
            member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; it is used
            only at creation time and is neither stored nor returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, '/api/owners/' followed by
                the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space and
                the last name (e.g. 'DR Who') when a title is present, or just the
                last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The integer version of the owner response shape. Always 2 for this
                version-2 owner identity release.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's version-2 identity, grouping the derived identifiers
                (memberId, identityKey and householdId). Each identifier mixes in a
                fixed 'V2' version tag, so no value produced under version 1 is produced
                again. The user-facing 'locality', 'timezone' and 'ownerSegment' remain
                the plain region code and never carry the 'V2' tag.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named
                by the calendar year in which it ends, so a registration date on or
                after 1 July belongs to the following calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, the score the membershipLevel is
                derived from. Starts at 0 and gains 2 when an email address is
                present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2
                for a household of 3 or more members (householdSize is at least
                3), and 3 when the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed
                fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July). A newly created
                owner (zero tenure) is never awarded the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from the
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points,
                level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-

/**
     * Builds this owner's member id, formatted {@code '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'}. {@code REGION} is
     * the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city, then {@code 'UNKNOWN'}; see
     * {@link #deriveRegion()}); {@code FY} is the two-digit fiscal year of the
     * {@link #getRegistrationDate() registration date} (the fiscal year starts on 1 July; see
     * {@link #fiscalYearOf(LocalDate)}); {@code HASH8} is the first 8 upper-case hexadecimal
     * characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's normalized telephone concatenated with its last
     * name (the same hash the region-and-hash identity uses); and {@code CHK} is a single Luhn check
     * digit over the digits of the {@code <REGION><FY><HASH8>} prefix (e.g. {@code 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'}).
     * It carries no sequence number, so it is a pure function of the owner's region, fiscal year,
     * telephone and last name. Call this once at create time and store the result via
     * {@link #setMemberId(String)}, which thereafter backs {@link #getLocality()} and
     * {@link #getFiscalYear()}.
     *
     * @return the assembled member id
     */
    public String buildMemberId() {
        String base = deriveRegion()
            + String.format("%02d", fiscalYearOf(this.registrationDate) % 100)
            + sha256Hex8(this.telephone + this.getLastName());
        return base + luhnCheckDigit(base);
    }
